en-US.description: A singbox GUI based on flutter.
en-US.longDescription:
Karing is a singbox GUI based on flutter. It features
- Compatible with Clash, V2ray/V2fly, Sing-box, Shadowsocks, Sub, Github Subscriptions.
  - Full clash config supported, Partial clash.meta config supported.
- A set of routing rules applied to multiple subscription sources automatically selects efficient nodes.
- Supports custom routing rule groups and node groups.
  - Customizes default routing rule groups for novice users - ready to use right out of the box.
  - Built-in geo-IP, geo-site, ACL, and other rulesets
- Backup and synchronization, synchronizing multiple devices with a single configuration.
  - Supports iCloud synchronization [IOS/MacOS].
  - Supports synchronization within the local area network.
  - Supports WebDAV.
  - Supports importing/exporting ZIP files.
- Built-in support for the modified sing-box core.
- Introduces a beginner mode for simpler configuration.
- Plan to support more platforms.
en-US.name: Karing
en-US.releaseNotes:
1. Fixed an issue where invalid IP/CIDR values   could be added (e.g., in 'Excluded Routes').
2. Fixed an issue where errors during the startup of core components (Mieru, Naive, Tailscale, or Tor) would cause VPN connection failures.
3. Fixed several instances of 'panic' in the core.
4. 'TLS: Skip certificate verification' is now disabled by default (if you encounter connection failures with certain nodes, please enable this option and try again). #2079
iOS/tvOS AppStore: (Search Keywords: karing vpn) https://apps.apple.com/us/app/karing/id6472431552

zh-CN.description: 一个基于 flutter 的 singbox 图形用户界面。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Karing 是一个基于 flutter 的 singbox 图形用户界面。具备：
- 兼容 Clash、V2ray/V2fly、Sing-box、Shadowsocks、Sub、Github 订阅。
  - 完全支持 clash 配置，部分支持 clash.meta 配置。
- 一套路由规则应用于多个订阅源，自动选择高效节点。
- 支持自定义路由规则组、节点组
  - 为小白用户定制默认路由规则组 - 开箱即用。
  - 内置 geo-ip、geo-site、acl 等规则集
- 备份和同步，一次配置多设备同步
  - 支持局域网内同步
  - 支持 Webdav
  - 支持 zip 文件导入/导出
- 内置支持 魔改版 singbox 核心。
- 增加新手模式 配置更简单。
- 计划支持所有平台。
